documents.title: Hardware warranty
documents.text: Beacon hardware has a 12 months warranty from the delivery date. Accidental damage is excluded.

documents.title: Return window
documents.text: Customers can return unused hardware within 14 days of delivery. A return authorization is required.

documents.title: Replacement shipment
documents.text: A replacement device ships within 2 business days after the support team approves the request.

documents.title: MFA account recovery
documents.text: Users who lose an authenticator can sign in with a recovery code. Support cannot bypass multi-factor authentication.

cases.question: How long is the hardware warranty?
